## React and React DOM

`brand-orbs-island.js` includes React 19.1.1 and React DOM 19.1.1. Their package
metadata declares the MIT License. Repository: <https://github.com/facebook/react>.

## esbuild

esbuild 0.25.4 was used only to create the local bundle; it is not shipped as a
runtime dependency. Its package metadata declares the MIT License.
